question: Who among the following won the Mexican Formula 1 Grand Prix 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Max Verstappen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Max Verstappen:-**

 
 
• He is a Dutch formula 1 racing driver.
 
• Red Bull's Max Verstappen won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on 12 June 2022.
 
• This is Verstappen's 25th GP win of his career.
 
• This is also Verstappen's maiden win at Azerbaijan GP and a first podium as well.
 
• Red Bull's Sergio Perez claimed second place while Mercedes duo of George Russell and Lewis Hamilton finished third and fourth respectively.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carlos Sainz Jr:-**

 
 
• He is a Spanish racing driver currently competing in Formula One for Scuderia Ferrari.13 He is the son of Carlos Sainz Sr., a double World Rally Champion.
 
 
 
• **Lando Norris:**
 
 
• Racing under the British flag, Lando Norris is a Belgian-British driver who currently competes in Formula One with McLaren.
 
• The 2017 FIA Formula 3 European Championship was won by him. 
 
 
 
• **Charles Leclerc:-**
 
 
• He is a Monegasque racing driver who competes in Formula 1 for Scuderia Ferrari.
 
• He made his Formula 1 debut in 2018 with the Sauber team (now Alfa Romeo Racing) and joined Ferrari in the 2019 season.
